job.rawJd:
General recruiter and networking profile, not an employer posting.

Target: healthcare and pharmaceutical agency account management, client strategy, and adjacent client-services roles.

Core work: own client relationships; manage budgets, briefs, timelines, national broadcast and integrated campaign delivery, cross-functional teams, FDA preclearance, and med-legal and MLR review; use research and campaign performance to guide client recommendations.

Resume architecture: lead with direct account management, broken out by agency so title progression and tenure are visible. Give that work the most space. Keep every later employer and date visible with the recent bullets that strengthen client discovery, stakeholder alignment, regulated delivery, recommendations, or team leadership.

This package must be fit-gated again against each employer's actual job description before application.

classification.primarySource: The 2011-2018 account-management resumes are the main content source. They directly prove consumer account ownership across pharma and consumer brands, brand budgets up to $20M, national television launches, FDA and med-legal review, digital and loyalty programs, vendor coordination, and junior account oversight, with the title progression from Account Coordinator through Account Supervisor.
classification.supportingSource: The current resume and portfolio supply the later chronology and selected proof of client discovery, regulated workflows, presentation-ready recommendations, and cross-functional leadership. Those roles support the story but do not receive equal weight.

resumeBase.rationale: This is the approved healthcare account-leadership networking profile. Direct account ownership, regulated pharma delivery, budgets, and title progression are the primary operating center; UX and AI remain supporting evidence.

supportedOverlap: 8 years of direct Fortune 500 pharma and healthcare account management with brand budgets up to $20M, from Account Coordinator through Account Supervisor and Digital Strategist.
Three years leading the Jazz Pharmaceuticals XYREM consumer account at Scout Marketing, including the first unbranded social campaign for the brand and for Jazz.
Consumer account leadership on FCB Health's largest pharma business, including three national television launches within one year and a 45% increase in new-to-brand consumers within seven weeks.
Direct responsibility for market research, FDA preclearance, med-legal approval, broadcast production, network clearances, OPDP submissions, and weekly client financial reporting.

missingEvidence: Employer-specific requirements such as Salesforce or CRM ownership, renewals, retention, quota, contract negotiation, or sales operations must be checked against each posting before this general package is used.

resume.summary: Looking to make a return to healthcare account management. Over eight years on Fortune 500 pharma brands, I progressed from Account Coordinator to Account Supervisor, managed budgets up to $20M, and guided work through FDA, OPDP, and med-legal review. In UX, I grew a design team from 2 to 30. Today, I lead client AI engagements from discovery through delivery. I'm coming back with deeper experience building teams, shaping products, and using AI to solve client problems while keeping the relationship at the center.
